Verified by vc 2026-09-09 17:02Z, red control re-run in the refusing form at 17:16Z. THREE INSTRUMENTS OVER TWO WINDOWS, AND THE DETECTOR WAS PROVED LIVE IN BOTH DIRECTIONS BEFORE THE ZERO WAS READ. Window: 3e39d5d (last commit before WP-01) to HEAD. WP-01's manifest work is c5afc33 (workspace + artifact path dep) and 47c2ebc (resolver pin); showreel's packages arrive later at 8dea619 in WP-03 and are outside this row.

(1) COMRAK LINE BYTE-IDENTICAL. `git show 3e39d5d:opt/prez/crate/Cargo.toml | grep '^comrak'` against the same grep at HEAD: 56 bytes each, `cmp` exit 0. Population control, exactly one `^comrak` line at each endpoint, 1 and 1, three mentions each (the other two are the comment explaining default-features). Independently `git log -S` puts the line's last change at 64d375b, ST0010/03, before ST0017 existed.

(2) PREZ'S COMPILED CLOSURE, ONE INSTRUMENT AT BOTH ENDPOINTS. A detached worktree at 3e39d5d and the working tree, both through one shell function with identical flags, so the two readings cannot differ by invocation. Closure including first-party 18 to 19. THIRD-PARTY ONLY, with the first-party names DERIVED from the workspace manifest rather than typed: 17 to 17, SYMMETRIC DIFFERENCE 0 over a named population of 17 -- caseless, comrak, entities, fastrand, finl_unicode, jetscii, phf, phf_codegen, phf_generator, phf_shared, rustc-hash, siphasher, smallvec, tinyvec, tinyvec_macros, typed-arena, unicode-normalization. Name-only dedup equals name+version dedup at both ends, so no two-versions-of-one-package hides inside the count.

(3) THE LOCKFILE, ON ITS OWN WINDOW, 3e39d5d to c5afc33: 25 to 26 entries, symmetric difference exactly {artifact}, third-party 24 to 24.

RED CONTROL BOTH DIRECTIONS. Removing one real package from the HEAD side (smallvec) takes the symmetric difference 0 to 1 and NAMES smallvec. Adding one (serde) takes it 0 to 1 and NAMES serde. The `comm -23` arm was separately observed firing at 7 in this session on the lockfile-versus-closure comparison. SO THE ZERO IS A DETECTOR ZERO OVER A FULL POPULATION -- neither a census zero nor a tautology.

AND THIS EVIDENCE WAS CORRECTED AGAINST AC-1.15 ON THE SAME CONTRACT, WHICH IS THE POINT OF A BINDING ROW. The first run of the red control PRINTED its application check -- "injection applied? removed 1 line(s), expected 1" -- and carried on regardless of the answer. AC-1.15 says the applying step REFUSES rather than warns, and a print is a warn: had the injection matched nothing, the line would have read "removed 0 line(s), expected 1" and the symmetric difference would have printed underneath it looking exactly like a result. Re-run at 17:16Z with an `apply_or_refuse` step that exits non-zero on a wrong delta; both injections applied (delta -1 and +1) and both named their package. THE REFUSING STEP IS ITSELF RED-PROVED: a no-op injection, the file copied unchanged, is REFUSED at exit 1 with "changed the file by 0 line(s), expected -1 -- injection did not apply". That is the arm the print form did not have.

THE ABSENCE ASSERTION IS PAIRED WITH A PRESENCE ASSERTION OVER ONE POPULATION COMPUTED ONCE. The 17 are NAMED, not merely counted, so deleting prez's dependency would fail this row rather than pass it.

CC'S FIGURE RECONCILES EXACTLY, AND THE GAP WAS A POPULATION RATHER THAN AN ERROR. cc measured prez at 17 on normal+build edges and 13 on normal; vc measured 19 and 15 counting prez and artifact themselves. 19-2=17 and 15-2=13. Both readings correct, one naming first-party out.

ARTIFACT IS STD-ONLY BY MEASUREMENT AND NOT BY ITS COMMENT. Its `[dependencies]` table is present and empty; it contributes ZERO packages to prez's closure, the whole delta being artifact itself; its source resolves only std, crate and super. The manifest is conclusive -- a crate cannot be reached without being declared -- and the closure count is the second instrument.

THE ROW WAS CORRECTED TO ITS INTENT BEFORE BEING SATISFIED, NOT WEAKENED TO FIT. As written it named the lockfile, and the workspace lockfile now stands at 79 entries: a later reader running the row's own instrument would read 24 to 76 and call the row false. The intent, that WP-01 adds no third-party cost to prez, held before the edit. The replacement instrument is STRICTER -- what compiles rather than what resolves -- and is measured at HEAD rather than at WP-01's commit, which is the harder window, since showreel has since joined the workspace and reaches prez through the shared crate.
